Attaining FLN for all children must not become an immediate national mission.

The vision of FLN Mission is to create an enabling environment in all aspects to ensure universal acquisition of FLN in primary classes by 2025 so that every child achieves the desired learning competencies in reading, writing and numeracy at the end of Class III and not later than Class V.

Students, along with their schools, teachers, parents, and communities, must be urgently supported and encouraged in every way possible to help carry out this all-important target and mission, which indeed forms the basis of all future learning.
